questions.q: To which place did the man then bring Ezekiel?
questions.a: The man then brought Ezekiel to the gate that opened to the east.

questions.q: What did Ezekiel see and from what direction did it come?
questions.a: Ezekiel saw the glory of the God of Israel come from the east.

questions.q: How did Ezekiel get to the inner court?
questions.a: The Spirit lifted Ezekiel up and brought him to the inner court.

questions.q: What did Yahweh say he would do in the inner court?
questions.a: Yahweh said he would place his throne there and would live in the midst of the people of Israel there forever.

questions.q: In what way would the people of Israel no longer profane Yahweh’s holy name?
questions.a: The people of Israel would no longer profane Yahweh’s holy name by putting the thresholds of their shrines next to Yahweh’s.

questions.q: What would Israel have to do in order for Ezekiel to reveal to them the design of the house?
questions.a: Israel would have to be ashamed of their sins in order for Ezekiel to reveal to them the design of the house.

questions.q: What did Yahweh tell Ezekiel to do about the house he had seen in the vision?
questions.a: Yahweh told Ezekiel to tell the house of Israel about the house he had seen in the vision.

questions.q: What did Yahweh say was the regulation for the house?
questions.a: Yahweh said the regulation for the house was that it would be most holy.

questions.q: For what would the hearth on the altar be used?
questions.a: The hearth on the altar would be used for the burnt offerings.

questions.q: What things pointed upward on the hearth?
questions.a: There were four horns pointing upward on the hearth.

questions.q: What did Yahweh say would be the sin offering for the Levitical priests on the first day?
questions.a: Yahweh said a bull from the cattle would be a sin offering for the Levitical priests on the first day.

questions.q: Whose descendants would serve as the Levitical priests at this altar?
questions.a: The descendants of Zadok would serve as Levitical priests at this altar.

questions.q: What would placing the blood on the altar do for it?
questions.a: Placing the blood on the altar would cleanse it and make atonement for it.

questions.q: What did Yahweh say would be the sin offering for the Levitical priests on the second day?
questions.a: Yahweh said a male goat without blemish would be a sin offering for the Levitical priests on the second day.

questions.q: What would the priests have to do for seven days in order to atone for the altar?
questions.a: The priests would have to prepare an unblemished bull and an unblemished ram as a burnt offering to atone for the altar.

questions.q: On the eighth day and onward, what did Yahweh declare he would do?
questions.a: On the eighth day and onward, Yahweh declared he would accept them.

commentary.text: After Ezekiel had surveyed the temple of God, he had a vision of the glory of God. When Christ crucified, and the things freely given to us of God, through Him, are shown to us by the Holy Ghost, they make us ashamed for our sins. This frame of mind prepares us for fuller discoveries of the mysteries of redeeming love; and the whole of the Scriptures should be opened and applied, that men may see their sins, and repent of them. We are not now to offer any atoning sacrifices, for by one offering Christ has perfected for ever those that are sanctified, Heb. 10:14; but the sprinkling of his blood is needful in all our approaches to God the Father. Our best services can be accepted only as sprinkled with the blood which cleanses from all sin.
